snippet.title: Evacuation Zone Tampere - Trailer - Pre demo 2025 - TOP #vrgame #indiegame
snippet.description:
WISHLIST! And take part in delivering this beautiful mayhem to your VR headset! 

SPECIAL THANKS TO FAMOUS CHARLES BROOKS! For Voice Over that is triple A level! 

Virtual Dawn is a community driven Unity SDK

Join up and become a creator or just have fun with XR creator community at https://discord.gg/pTdzDHC5ax

You can also join our XR GAMES channel where you can meet our makers and get give aways, demo sessions, feedback and more! https://discord.gg/39pXGj2c93

We have been doing XR since 2016 and we are here to enable you to become a creator and create a good place for adventurers in the new frontier of immersive apps! 

All support is welcome and we aim to give everyone a way to express themselves.
